capabilities: Fetch Google Ads and Meta Ads campaign metrics
Insert Markdown report tables for a chosen period
Add yesterday's report to new daily notes automatically
Save ad metrics as note properties
Render live ad-recap blocks with filters, sorting and currency overrides
extras: The Google Sheet connection relies on a published CSV link that anyone with the URL can read. On Obsidian versions before 1.11.4, API tokens fall back to data.json and sync with the vault. The roadmap lists Microsoft Ads, TikTok Ads, LinkedIn Ads, ad group breakdowns, weekly and monthly notes, and budget pacing alerts.
problem: Ad performance numbers live in platform dashboards, so marketers must copy them into their vault by hand to review them alongside their notes.
